definitions.explanation: The region between North America and South America, typically including countries from Guatemala to Panama.

examples.japanese: {中米|ちゅうべい}を{旅行|りょこう}した。
{中米|ちゅうべい}の{国々|くにぐに}はスペイン{語|ご}を{話|はな}す。
examples.english: The countries of Central America speak Spanish.

examples.japanese: コーヒーの{産地|さんち}として{有名|ゆうめい}な{中米|ちゅうべい}では、{多|おお}くの{農家|のうか}がコーヒー{栽培|さいばい}に{携|たずさ}わっている。
examples.english: In Central America, famous as a coffee-producing region, many farmers are involved in coffee cultivation.

notes:
An abbreviation of {中央|ちゅうおう}アメリカ (Central America). The {中|ちゅう} prefix meaning "middle/central" combines with {米|べい} (America), which is short for アメリカ. This follows the same pattern as other regional abbreviations.

RELATED REGIONAL TERMS:
- {北米|ほくべい}: North America
- {南米|なんべい}: South America
- {中南米|ちゅうなんべい}: Central and South America (Latin America)
- {米国|べいこく}: the United States (America)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中米|ちゅうべい}{諸国|しょこく}: Central American countries
- {中米|ちゅうべい}{産|さん}: produced in Central America
- {中米|ちゅうべい}{地域|ちいき}: the Central American region
